senses.gloss: m. (קנף, sec. r. of קף, cmp. צִינוֹק, צִנּוֹר &c.; an adaptation of κωνωπεῖον) the framework of a baldachin or canopy, consisting of four columns over which a flat cover is spread, contrad. to נַקְלִיטִין.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 1:3">Succ. I, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Sukkah 10a:13">10ᵃ</cite>) <he>או שפירס ע״ג ק׳</he> (not <he>שפירסה</he>) or if he spread a sheet over a frame (so as to form a tent within the Succah); ib. 10ᵇ Ms. M. (ed. <he>קינופות</he>).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 68a:1">Snh. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>הוא יושב בק׳ שלו</he> he was seated on his curtained couch.—Pl. <he>קִינוֹפוֹת</he>, <cite ref="S01016"><he>קִינּ׳</he></cite>. Succ. l. c. <he>וק׳ ארבעה</he>, v. <cite ref="N01224"><he>נַקְלִיטִין</he></cite>. Ib. <he>שאני ק׳ דקביעי</he> it is different with baldachin frames, for they are stationary, opp. to <cite ref="K00532"><he>כִּילָה</he></cite>.
Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 8.—[Κωνωπεῖον means the net, our w. refers to the frame.]
